commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin main
git reset --hard origin/main
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git cat-file -e 9d4b995^{commit}
git cherry-pick 9d4b995
cd projects/kobra2-neo
uv sync --frozen >/dev/null
uv run pytest -q
uv run python -m compileall -q src tests
uv run kobra-plot doctor >/dev/null
git diff --check
cd ../..
git push origin HEAD:main
echo RESULT:KOBRA_MAINTENANCE_CLOSED
